audit_limit: Previously used validation users; development audit, not independent blind test

epoch_profile.limit: Single local paired timing, not entire training or online latency
epoch_profile.scope: Serialized warm one-epoch loop including sampling/tensors/loss/backward/optimizer; excludes data/model setup, validation and cold start

independent_environment.scope: Existing independent locked environment, shared checkout/data/checkpoint; no new environment creation or retraining

kernel_profile.scope: Isolated same-minibatch forward/backward, excludes optimizer/evaluation; not online speed

multiple_comparisons: Exploratory unadjusted 95% intervals, not confirmatory claims

sampling_intervention.scope: Train-only sampler intervention check, no training or evaluation

timing_limit: Concurrent development training; not isolated model speed comparison
